TEAM_MEMBERS_DESC_LONG: Invite team members to collaborate in your Workspace and assign default roles across sites.
TEAM_INVITATIONS_DESC: Review invitations sent to you and manage invite links you created.
TEAM_ROLES_DESC: Configure access control for collaboration using a roles-permissions matrix.
TEAM_ROLES_MENU_SCOPE_DESC: Configure which menu entries are visible for a custom role. This only updates permissions referenced by the menu catalog; other permissions remain unchanged.
TEAM_ROLES_MENU_SCOPE_ROLE_HELP: Select which custom role should receive menu visibility updates.
TEAM_ROLES_MENU_SCOPE_NOTE: System roles are immutable. Create a custom role if you need a different menu scope.
TEAM_ROLES_MENU_SCOPE_NO_CUSTOM_ROLE: No custom roles yet. Create a custom role first, then configure its menu scope.
TEAM_ROLES_ADD_ROLE_DIALOG_DESC: Create a workspace-private custom role from a template.
TEAM_ROLES_FIELD_TEMPLATE_HELP: Choose a built-in role as the starting permission template.
TEAM_ROLES_FIELD_CODE_HELP: Used as a stable identifier (unique within workspace). Use lowercase letters and dashes.
TEAM_ROLES_FIELD_NAME_HELP: Use a clear and concise display name for admins.
TEAM_ROLES_FIELD_DESC_HELP: Describe what this role is intended to do.
TEAM_ROLES_DELETE_DESC: This will unbind the role from all members and cannot be undone. Target: {{roleName}}
TEAM_ROLES_PERMISSION_DIALOG_DESC: Select roles allowed to perform this permission (system roles are immutable).
TEAM_ROLES_PERMISSION_EMPTY_ROLES: No roles available for permission assignment.
TEAM_ROLES_EMPTY_SEARCH: No matching permissions or roles found
TEAM_INVITE_DIALOG_DESC: Invite others to help you build your workspace.
TEAM_INVITE_FIELD_TO_PLACEHOLDER: Enter one or more email addresses, one per line
TEAM_INVITE_FIELD_TO_HELP: Add the recipients that should receive this invitation.
TEAM_INVITE_ROLE_HELP: Invited members will join with this role by default. You can change roles later in Members.
TEAM_INVITE_FIELD_EXPIRES_HELP: Choose how long the invitation remains valid before it must be renewed.
TEAM_INVITE_LINK_ALLOWED_DOMAIN_HELP: Limit the invite link to users whose email ends with this domain.
TEAM_INVITE_VALIDATION_TO_REQUIRED: Please enter at least one email address
TEAM_SEARCH_PLACEHOLDER: Search by username / email / display name
TEAM_INVITATIONS_SEARCH_PENDING_PLACEHOL: Search pending invitations by email / role
TEAM_INVITATIONS_SEARCH_ACCEPTED_PLACEHO: Search accepted invitations by email / role
TEAM_EDIT_ROLES_DESC: Select roles for this member in the current workspace.
TEAM_EDIT_ROLES_FIELD_ROLE_HELP: Assign the most appropriate role for this member's current responsibilities.
TEAM_ROLE_CHANGE_FIELD_ROLE_HELP: Select the organization-level role to control baseline access and governance.
TEAM_EDIT_USER_DESC: Update this member's profile details and avatar in the current workspace. The username cannot be changed.
TEAM_RESET_PASSWORD_DESC: After resetting, the user must sign in with the new password.
TEAM_RESET_PASSWORD_FIELD_NEW_PASSWORD_H: Use a strong temporary password and share it through a secure channel.
TEAM_RESET_PASSWORD_FIELD_CONFIRM_PASSWO: Re-enter the same password to avoid accidental lockouts.
TEAM_FIELD_USERNAME_HELP: This account identifier is managed by the system and cannot be edited here.
TEAM_FIELD_DISPLAY_NAME_HELP: Set a friendly name teammates can recognize in member lists and activity records.
TEAM_FIELD_EMAIL_HELP: Update the contact email used for notifications and identity checks.
TEAM_FIELD_AVATAR_DESC: Click the avatar to pick or upload an image from the asset library.
TEAM_VALIDATION_PASSWORD_MIN: Password must be at least 8 characters
TEAM_VALIDATION_PASSWORD_MAX: Password must be at most 128 characters
TEAM_INVITATIONS_REVOKE_DESC: After revoking, {{email}} will no longer be able to use this invite link.
TEAM_INVITATIONS_RENEW_DESC: This will refresh the expiration time for {{email}}.
TEAM_INVITE_LINKS_EMPTY_DESC: Invite links let people join without an email invitation. Use “Invite member” to create a new invite link.
TEAM_INVITE_LINKS_SEARCH_PLACEHOLDER: Search invite links by code / role
TEAM_INVITE_LINK_MODE_NO_EMAILS: Invite link mode does not support email invites.
TEAM_INVITE_LINKS_DISABLE_ALL_DESC: This will disable all active invite links in your workspace.
TEAM_INVITE_LINKS_RENEW_DESC: Extend the expiration of invite link {{code}}.
TEAM_INVITE_LINK_CREATE_DESC: Invite links can be reused to let people join your workspace without email invites.
TEAM_INVITE_LINK_CREATE_SUCCESS_COPIED: Invite link created and copied to clipboard
TEAM_INVITE_EMAIL_TITLE: You have been invited to join workspace {workspace_name}
TEAM_INVITE_EMAIL_INTRO: You have been invited to join the workspace.
TEAM_INVITE_EMAIL_INTRO_WITH_INVITER: {inviter} invited you to join the workspace.
TEAM_INVITE_EMAIL_FALLBACK: If the button doesn't work, you can use the following token:
TEAM_INVITE_EMAIL_EXPIRES_AT: This invite link will expire at {expires_at} (UTC).
TEAM_INVITE_EMAIL_IGNORE: If you didn't request this, please ignore this email.
TEAM_EMPTY_DESC: Try adjusting your search or filters.
